verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents point-in-time snapshots of sandbox directories stored in R2, which can be restored later (docs-8, docs-48). These are directory-level filesystem snapshots, not whole-sandbox snapshots, and nothing explicitly documents forking new sandboxes from a snapshot. Missing for 10: whole-sandbox snapshots (process or memory state), an explicitly documented fork-to-new-sandbox flow, in-depth API detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
